subject: I discovered a secret mistake 90% of users make
preview_text: This changes how you scan for red flags. You heard it here first, before anyone else.
body_paragraphs: I was reviewing the data last night and noticed something that made me pause. A pattern so consistent, it felt like a gut punch. Users were scanning conversations, getting the red flags, and then... missing the single most important connection.

It's the difference between seeing a warning sign and understanding the entire warning system. The next update isn't just a new feature—it's a new way of seeing. It connects the dots between isolated incidents to show you the blueprint of a toxic pattern, not just the symptoms.

I'm calling it 'Pattern Blueprint.' It launches next week. Instead of just analyzing one screenshot, it learns from your past scans to map the entire emotional landscape. It shows you how love-bombing turns into gaslighting, how small manipulations build into big lies. You'll see the trajectory, not just the moment.

Open the app and scan one conversation you've been unsure about. Save it. When Pattern Blueprint goes live next week, it will be your first case study. I built this for the people who need to see the whole truth, not just pieces. P.S. The first 100 users to try the new feature get lifetime access to the advanced insights module—no extra charge.
cta_text: Open Red Flag Scanner AI & Save a Scan
